response.sql: WITH circuit_race_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) as race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_races, COUNT(DISTINCT circuitId) as total_circuits FROM races) SELECT crc.circuitId, crc.race_count, CAST(crc.race_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_races as share, (CAST(crc.race_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_races) - (1.0 / t.total_circuits) as margin_above_average FROM circuit_race_counts crc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE (CAST(crc.race_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_races) > (1.0 / t.total_circuits) ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
